hypothesis: The BODY's native morphology candidate-generation path can compile inherited L3 policy bindings from its own descendant morphology and consume those bindings before outcome access so that a child morphology generates/selects a different future candidate frontier than its no-policy parent under the same fresh residual and nominal budget.
falsifier: FAIL if the BODY candidate generator does not obtain policy bindings through canonical MorphologyCompiler, if a generator-policy child does not widen the future frontier under a binding-limited budget, if a mutator-policy child does not alter mutation-family priority, if REMOVE/no-policy behaves like FULL, if WRONG or residual-shuffled policies receive an intended-family effect, if outcomes/scores are consumed at generation time, or if cold restart changes the generated candidate set.
full_control: Use an inherited generated L3 descendant morphology as the generator's current BODY and run a fresh residual through the BODY policy-executing candidate path.
remove_control: Run the identical fresh residual and nominal budget from the no-policy parent morphology.
wrong_control: Use kind-mismatched policy ref and require canonical compile/generation failure.
shuffle_control: Use a policy bound to a different residual identity and require failure when the fresh residual identity is frozen.
restart_control: Cold reconstruct the same descendant morphology and rerun the fresh residual; candidate IDs/order must match.
